The reconstruction partially resolves the parent's provenance mismatch (2/3 definitions verified, 1 invalid due to copy-paste bug) but does not change the claim ceiling: truncation bias measurement remains blocked pending substrate fix (locatableSample cap removal) and canonical script commit. reason: PROVENANCE_PARTIAL: the uncommitted 3-definition per-role-filtered analysis is reconstructable from frozen raw evidence for DEF-FULL-MAP and DEF-FORM-ONLY within ±0.001 tolerance (reconstruction_complete.json). ISOLATED-A-LINK in stored analysis_results.json is invalid (byte-identical to DEF-FULL-MAP across all 7 tasks; audit V3 confirms copy-paste bug). The committed analyze.py uses a different algorithm (all-role density summing a+button+form+input+combobox+div+label+span) producing a different verdict (FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, 8 tasks, C3=false) vs stored results (SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST, 7 tasks, DEF-FULL-MAP C3=true). The directional finding (first-20 truncation introduces page-type-dependent ordering change) is robust across both algorithmic variants but the formal measurement remains invalid: (1) estimator inflates bias 4-7x by conflating total DOM counts (393-397 links) with locatable counts (~19 links) (audit V1); (2) committed script not updated with deduplication or per-definition filtering; (3) ISOLATED-A-LINK verdict unreliable. Measurement from parent EXP-INTEL-35124660457 cannot be unblocked until: (a) runtime lane removes locatableSample cap for true full DOM enumeration, (b) canonical analysis script is committed with 3-definition filtering and cart_1 deduplication. Audit REVISE status acknowledged; 6 required_fixes documented for next iteration.
